== Biography ==

Mabel is a girl of Alice's own age. By Alice's observation, she is one who knows very little—a child whose learning seems scarcely begun. Should Alice find herself transformed into Mabel, she imagines a life quite unlike her own: a small, poky house with hardly any toys to play with, and an endless succession of lessons to master.
